General Commentary - The transition from RiskOff to RiskOn++ illustrates an important feature of TurboRegime. The system does not remain permanently defensive after market conditions deteriorate. It reduces exposure when risk increases, but it is also designed to increase exposure rapidly when the underlying market environment improves sufficiently.

Those changes have removed several of the pressures that contributed to the September RiskOff environment.

Turbo Mode carries materially greater volatility and drawdown potential because SPXL provides leveraged exposure to the S&P 500. The objective is not simply to use leverage whenever the market is rising. RiskOn++ is reserved for periods when TurboRegime identifies sufficiently strong market conditions to justify that additional exposure.

After two weeks in RiskOff, the system is no longer playing defense. Turbo Mode is active.  Stops are in place should the TurboTrade fail.
